title: 手動車椅子の静的プロップ
description: 公共施設の入口、待合室や街路シーンに配置する汎用手動車椅子。大きなスポーク車輪と外側ハンドリム、前部キャスター、左右独立のフットレスト、肘掛け、張り地付き座面と背、後方グリップ、座面下の交差支えを造形しています。人、介助者や別体クッションは含みません。固定姿勢の外観用モデルで、走行・折り畳み・ブレーキ・移動支援の機能はなく、医療用途、荷重定格や安全認証を示しません。製品設計や操作指示ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.714 × 0.935 × 1.040 m、22,084三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A generic manual wheelchair appearance prop for public-building entrances, waiting areas and street scenes. Large spoked wheels have outboard handrims, with small front casters, individual footplates, armrests, upholstered seat and back, rear push grips and crossed under-seat supports. No person, attendant or separate cushion is included. Fixed static geometry has no rolling, folding, braking or mobility-assistance function and claims no clinical suitability, load rating or safety certification. It is not a product design or operating guidance. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.714 × 0.935 × 1.040 m; 22,084 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
